description: List pages in a document. Requires documentId or documentName.

detail_level.description: Controls response verbosity. 'names' returns id/name only for efficient navigation. 'detailed' returns full page metadata. Default: detailed.

max_page_depth.description: Max depth for page listing. Default: -1 (all).

team_id.description: The ClickUp Team ID or Workspace Name to use. If provided, the server will switch to this workspace for this and subsequent requests in the current session.

name: list_document_pages
